# apple_analytics_report_segments (Data Source)

Lists the segments of an analytics report instance: the files that hold its data, with the URLs they download from.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "apple_analytics_report_segments" "latest" {
  instance_id = data.apple_analytics_report_instances.daily.instances[0].id
}

output "report_urls" {
  value     = data.apple_analytics_report_segments.latest.segments[*].url
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `instance_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the instance; see `data.apple_analytics_report_instances`.

### Read-Only

- `segments` (Attributes List) The segments. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--segments))

<a id="nestedatt--segments"></a>
### Nested Schema for `segments`

Read-Only:

- `checksum` (String) Checksum of the file.
- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the segment.
- `size_in_bytes` (Number) Size of the file in bytes.
- `url` (String, Sensitive) URL the file downloads from.
